'''Sheani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked as a [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] at the [[Varykino/Legends|Lake Retreat]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sheani appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
